name: San Rafael River (Little Grand Canyon)
gaugeName: San Rafael River near Green River, UT
blurb: Spring-runoff float through the Little Grand Canyon of the San Rafael Swell. Gauge is ~60 river miles downstream of the run.

sections.notes: BLM: float only in small craft above 200 cfs, large craft above 500 cfs; usually floatable only in spring runoff. BLM gives ~18 miles (hike distance). Gauge 09328500 is far downstream - treat timing as approximate.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
